Bhusu(śu)kriyā
(conjectured name) Bud. tantra. by Bhuśukra or Śāntideva, a yogin. Rep. p. 20.
This speaks both on Hindu an. Buddhist tantras in the same strain. It refers of Bodhicitta an. Ājñācakra etc. mentions obscene rites an. gives vivid picture of the last stage of Tāntrika Buddhism in [Page189a] India of the Vajrayāna school. The a. seems to have been held in great respect before the advent of Gorakṣanātha an. other Nāthas of the 13th Century.
